All five exact floor entries currently contain authority; retaining them is not loosening but no canonical exception permits them at final acceptance3/PhaseB:
- dispatch: request schema/admission/revalidation, scope/human/native grant/principal/delegation/presenter binding, always-human/sticky exclusion semantics; keep raw transport/files/prompt/CLI orchestration outside.
- mandate_drive: restart eligibility and cap/spec/owner/TTY/profile checks, action scope/gate mappings, held-PR forced floors, every-spec exclusions and drive-specific recheck/inline consent mapping; keep loops/locks/state/events/process effects outside.
- mandate_traces: protected mandate_ship trusts collect_pr/collect selected IDs+paths and store_snapshot_stable, so evidence pinning/selection/fallback/stability meaning must be protected. Raw Git acquisition/history/report plumbing may remain outside, never an unprotected trusted-empty/stable result.
- relay_launch: small trusted launch/lineage schema/parser/private reads and append/sync writer/cap identity cluster, not a relay scheduler; spawning remains outside.
- pr_ship_batch: review_state/ci_from_rollup and bounded human typed-consent/clear+ship checks belong protected; branch refresh/poll/wait/UI/event/port orchestration stays outside. No new permit/policy framework.

Minimal existing-function/inline-block pure-move seams, exact caller lists and mixed-test splits are in report. Preserve serde/refusal/prompt bytes and short-circuit/effect ordering. Final callers direct to gate; no unprotected reexport or test #[path] mount. Protect live test mounts/fixtures with assertions; regex hits/string mount presence is not full authority proof. No protection removal, expanded exemption, rename-to-evade or acceptance deferral proposed.
